# T0201 visual smoke

Captured from the production-style loopback app on a disposable populated SQLite copy, 26 September 2026. Desktop: 1440×1000; mobile: 390×844. Opaque slate masks intentionally hide private document titles/Markdown; they are evidence redaction, not app UI. No source data, plan contents or credentials are included.

All eight PNGs were inspected. This Week and Upcoming show distinct Monday–Sunday ranges, Europe/Zagreb calendar basis and persisted-save metadata. General Plan retains Reload/Edit and its existing saved timestamp. History is secondary, read-only and truthfully empty because migration did not fabricate past commitments. Mobile controls wrap into two rows; dates, actions and metadata remain readable without horizontal overflow. General Plan's existing Back to chat button wraps but remains reachable. Browser reload preserved the confirmed current plan.

Document rendering safety, original/latest and as-of metadata, paged historical detail/correction intent, stale-request handling and streaming/JSON refresh also have deterministic tests. Screenshots alone do not establish semantic coaching correctness.
